_meta.source: Converted from sydevs/SahajAtlasWeb@main:public/locales/en/{common,events}.json through Appendix A of sydevs/SahajCloud#706.
_meta.schema_version: post-#1256 (12 tabs, 43 leaf groups, grouped by widget view)
_meta.excluded: emails and event.title are omitted on purpose — both hold live production data and are never overwritten by a seed. A key whose English is declared as a schema default is omitted too: translationsSchema.json is its one home, and the importer merges it in.
_meta.omitted_keys: A key this locale has no translation for is omitted, never blank. The client-read English merge (#705) serves English for it.
